# biolab-runners

> Standalone, modular scientific runners with shared execution, artifact,
> error, and provenance contracts.
>
> Release status: `0.6.0` release candidate on commit
> `5b51dc387474bf03318aed853e8c415ad1a58d58`; not published or tagged.

## Documentation

- [README](https://github.com/Lambda-Biolab/biolab-runners/blob/main/README.md): Project overview, features, install, quick start
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/Lambda-Biolab/biolab-runners/blob/main/AGENTS.md): Project purpose, architecture, domain rules, QA
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/Lambda-Biolab/biolab-runners/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): Contributor workflow, PR guidelines, code style
- [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/Lambda-Biolab/biolab-runners/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): Version history

## Source — biolab_runners

### Core

- [biolab_runners/__init__.py](https://github.com/Lambda-Biolab/biolab-runners/blob/main/biolab_runners/__init__.py): Package root and code version (`0.6.0`; release candidate, not yet published/tagged)
- [biolab_runners/contracts.py](https://github.com/Lambda-Biolab/biolab-runners/blob/main/biolab_runners/contracts.py): Normalized statuses, execution modes, typed errors, and artifact references
- [biolab_runners/provenance.py](https://github.com/Lambda-Biolab/biolab-runners/blob/main/biolab_runners/provenance.py): Shared execution provenance and digest conventions

Shared contract names: `ExecutionStatus`, `ExecutionMode`,
`ArtifactReference`, `RunnerError` and its typed subclasses,
`ProvenanceMetadata`, `artifact_from_path()`, `require_artifact()`, and
`validate_artifact_digest()`. Runner configs/results remain tool-specific; no
universal `Runner` base class exists. Required artifacts fail closed. The
status vocabulary is `pending`, `running`, `succeeded`, `failed`,
`unsupported`, `timeout`, `interrupted`, `malformed`, `incomplete`, `cached`,
and `dry_run`; execution modes are `in_process`, `subprocess`, and
`container_uri`.

### Boltz-2 structure prediction (boltz2/)

Public API: `Boltz2Config`, `PocketConstraint`, `Boltz2Runner`.

- [boltz2/__init__.py](https://github.com/Lambda-Biolab/biolab-runners/blob/main/biolab_runners/boltz2/__init__.py): Re-exports `Boltz2Config`, `PocketConstraint`, `Boltz2Runner`
- [boltz2/runner.py](https://github.com/Lambda-Biolab/biolab-runners/blob/main/biolab_runners/boltz2/runner.py): `Boltz2Runner` — invokes `boltz predict` CLI, parses confidence scores, applies quality gate
- [boltz2/config.py](https://github.com/Lambda-Biolab/biolab-runners/blob/main/biolab_runners/boltz2/config.py): `Boltz2Config`, `PocketConstraint` dataclasses; quality gate thresholds
- [boltz2/utils.py](https://github.com/Lambda-Biolab/biolab-runners/blob/main/biolab_runners/boltz2/utils.py): YAML input writer, output parser, `boltz` CLI availability check

### OpenMM molecular dynamics (openmm/)

Public API: `OpenMMConfig`, `OpenMMRunner`, `GateVerdict`, `evaluate_trajectory`,
`latest_verdict_file`, `load_verdict`, `write_verdict_file`.

- [openmm/__init__.py](https://github.com/Lambda-Biolab/biolab-runners/blob/main/biolab_runners/openmm/__init__.py): Re-exports the public API
- [openmm/runner.py](https://github.com/Lambda-Biolab/biolab-runners/blob/main/biolab_runners/openmm/runner.py): `OpenMMRunner` — thin dispatcher; calls `run_state.decide()` then acts on the returned `RunPlan`
- [openmm/config.py](https://github.com/Lambda-Biolab/biolab-runners/blob/main/biolab_runners/openmm/config.py): `OpenMMConfig` (incl. `physiological`/`saliva`/`gastric`/`intestinal` preset classmethods), `SimulationResult`
- [openmm/run_state.py](https://github.com/Lambda-Biolab/biolab-runners/blob/main/biolab_runners/openmm/run_state.py): Pre-run decision tree — `decide()` returns a tagged-union `RunPlan` (`FreshPlan`/`ResumePlan`/`SkipPlan`/`FailurePlan`)
- [openmm/checkpoint.py](https://github.com/Lambda-Biolab/biolab-runners/blob/main/biolab_runners/openmm/checkpoint.py): Checkpoint lifecycle — `atomic_save_checkpoint`, `quarantine_stale_checkpoint`, `load_checkpoint`, `inspect_checkpoint`, `CompletionStatus` enum
- [openmm/system_builder.py](https://github.com/Lambda-Biolab/biolab-runners/blob/main/biolab_runners/openmm/system_builder.py): ForceField + Modeller + System + Integrator assembly; Cα restraint; `Simulation` construction
- [openmm/offline_gate.py](https://github.com/Lambda-Biolab/biolab-runners/blob/main/biolab_runners/openmm/offline_gate.py): Offline mdtraj gate — `evaluate_trajectory`, verdict I/O, `GateVerdict`
- [openmm/geometry.py](https://github.com/Lambda-Biolab/biolab-runners/blob/main/biolab_runners/openmm/geometry.py): Pure-numpy PBC helpers — `pbc_correct`, `min_pbc_distance`, `collect_chain_ca_positions`
- [openmm/paths.py](https://github.com/Lambda-Biolab/biolab-runners/blob/main/biolab_runners/openmm/paths.py): `FileNames` — centralized production filenames
- [openmm/utils.py](https://github.com/Lambda-Biolab/biolab-runners/blob/main/biolab_runners/openmm/utils.py): Availability checks (`openmm_available`, `pdbfixer_available`) + diagnostic reporter (`verify_production_outputs`)

### Contracted tool runners

- `rfdiffusion/`: `RFdiffusionConfig`, `RFdiffusionRunner`, and
  `RFdiffusionResult`; direct subprocess via the package `rfdiffusion` adapter.
- `proteinmpnn/`: `ProteinMPNNConfig`, `ProteinMPNNRunner`,
  `ProteinMPNNResult`; direct subprocess via the package `proteinmpnn`
  adapter, or container URI through `${PROTEINMPNN_BIN}`.
- `peptide_prep/`: `PeptidePrepConfig`, `PeptideTopologyDescriptor`,
  `PeptidePrepRunner`, and `PeptidePrepResult`; in-process optional scientific
  dependencies, with required `prepared.pdb`, `prepared.top`, and
  `prepared.gro` artifacts.
- `rosetta/`: `RosettaConfig`, `RosettaRunner`, and `RosettaResult`; direct
  subprocess with an optional container URI.
- `gromacs/`: `GromacsRunner`, `GromacsProtocolRunner`, and their result
  records; direct subprocess with an optional container URI.
- `mmpbsa/`: `GmxMMPBSARunner`, `GmxMMPBSAStatus`, and
  `GmxMMPBSARecord`; legacy dict result with shared metadata,
  returning `unsupported` when the optional tool is unavailable and
  `incomplete` when required decomposition output is absent. A configured
  container URI is recorded, but the current command builder does not launch
  the container.
